doc_type: <one of the pack's declared doc types>
notes: <one or two sentences: what this template looks like and why the selectors are shaped as they are>

field_selectors.anchor: <the printed label to find first — omit if the region alone locates the value>
field_selectors.region: <one of: any-page, first-page, header-block, label-block, last-page, last-table-row, line_items, near-anchor, remittance-block, same-cell, same-row, top-center, top-left, top-right, totals-block>
field_selectors.pattern: <a named pattern kind, or a regex describing the SHAPE of the value>
adjust: <zero or more adjust ops, in order>
field_selectors.required: <true if the pack cannot route this document without it; otherwise omit>

field_selectors.table_anchor: <the printed column header that starts the table>
